newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint firms against dollar and basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint firms against dollar and basket.

text.p: The Hungarian forint firmed against both the dollar and the currency basket in Monday afternoon trade.

The Hungarian unit moved closer to the top of the central bank's 4.5-percent intervention band to end 35 pips from the resistance level (bid) at 175.75 to the dollar, compared to a midday level of 175.95/176.00, dealers said.

"There didn't seem to be any particular reason for the strengthening," said Gabor Butor of Unicbank. "It was a balanced market in the morning, but the gap from the bid closed from 50 to 35 fillers in afternoon trade."
Butor said the recent mass withdrawals by depositors from Postabankn had a negligible effect on the market.
"The forint (weakened) slightly this morning, but that was all. It rallied in the afternoon," he said.

The forint usually floats at the top end of the intervention band against a basket made up 70 percent of the mark and 30 percent of the dollar. The 4.5-percent band represents a range of around seven forints.
